About Nduma

A friendly guest house in Mafemani-B. Our rooms open onto a paved courtyard with gardens and palm trees, and guests can cool off in our swimming pool with its covered seating area.

Questions

How do I book?

Use the Book tab, choose your room, stay and date, then send the inquiry on WhatsApp. We reply to confirm availability.

What are the rates?

Rooms: 3 hours R150, day R350, night R350. Pool: adults R50, kids R30.

Can children use the pool?

Yes, but children may not swim alone.
